description: THREAT-EV. Round 1 of the Custodes mirror, P1 Movement, both seats HUMAN. P2's Allarus Custodians (275pt melee unit) is staged just past obj_nml_2, away from P1's main body, so a P1 unit heading there is its only target. Clicking Suggest (K) opens the breakdown card. A move into charge reach is scored by its expected outcome: 'Likely dead before it scores' cuts the plan by P(charged and wiped) (2D6 charge odds after the enemy's Move x the chance its expected damage wipes the unit, weighted by how attractive the unit is to that enemy vs other targets), 'Unit at risk' charges the VP the loss would cost, and the card's Facts show 'Survives the enemy's charge'. Each candidate is logged as [THREAT-EV]. Nothing is executed.
